purpose: Native deployed V8 binding and existing symbolic engine; separate from uniform JSON end-to-end task
selection: All three frozen E1 endpoints, no current-data tuning
shared_input: Same evidence text, roles, display/time scope and state question wording. Original-question context preserved. Native output instructions replace generic answer protocol.
unscored_padding: Repeat first real proposition to fill unused B/C/D, then discard padding outputs
scope: 46 state fields;27other evidence-test nonstate fields unsupported; full87 coverage reported
rule: Each requested state itself is an identity proposition; native bindings s/r map TFUC and existing certified_decision runs on each field. This benchmark does not measure composite AND/OR rule correctness.
